title: Measurement
description: Generic scalar value with full provenance. Used for every scientific/environmental field returned by a data agent. §43. RECONSTRUCTED from the architecture doc — diff against the actual locked Measurement.json before use.

parameter.description: Canonical field name, e.g. 'wind_speed_ms'. Optional when Measurement is nested under a named key rather than used in a flat array.

unit.description: RESOLVED (was an open anomaly): must match shared-config/canonical-units.json for this field's parameter/key name — e.g. a 'wind_speed_ms' key must always carry unit 'm/s'. Not enforceable by this schema alone (the parameter name is a dynamic map key, not a fixed property here); enforced at runtime by enforceCanonicalUnit() at the adapter stage (§24.2), then again by validateContract.js after structural validation passes.

source.description: Provider name, e.g. 'INCOIS', 'IMD', 'Open-Meteo Marine'. Null when status is 'missing' or 'not_mapped' — no source exists for data that was never retrieved. §43

product_id.description: Dataset/product identifier distinct from the provider name, e.g. 'OSF-v2'. §43

valid_time.description: Forecast or observation valid time, not the retrieval time.

official_source.description: Present only for official warning-derived fields. Additional provenance required for safety-critical warnings. §43.1

affected_area.description: Named coastal segment (string) or a GeoJSON polygon (object) defining the warning area. §49.1

warning_level.description: Maps to the minimum Risk floor per §49.2.
